text:
ashley.k: FYI FinLedger is seeing repeated timeouts and 502s hitting /v1/generate on Dedicated. Customer notified, flagged as potential SLA risk. Ticket INC-4521. Need engineering commitment on mitigation and ETA.

sre-bot: ALERT: 502 spike (p95 latency 1.8s -> 12s) observed across pool finledger-dedicated-1 starting 09:12 PST.

devin: Thanks. Can someone capture recent serve logs + top slow traces? tagging @juno for runtime triage. Is this correlated with the model rollout from earlier today?

juno: I’m looking now. Early signs point to a model-variant fallback loop hitting the prefix cache, causing extra KV invalidations + re-batching. Could be the rollout that toggled quantized shard mapping. Reproducing locally.

maria.cs: Customer is on a committed SLA and asking for a short ETA. They can tolerate a short rollback window but want a clear workaround within 30m.

tamir.infra: Pool-level health shows repeated worker restarts ~09:14. I can hold a quick rolling restart of the pool, but that’s a heavier op — could help if there’s stuck threads. Need owner to approve.

devin: If it’s the fallback loop, lighter mitigation is to pin the customer to the previous model_variant until we patch. Juno, can you provide the API call we can tell CS to use?

juno: Yes. Workaround to pin via API / console:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/customers/finledger/route \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RB_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "redwood-2.1-stable","model_variant": "v1"}'
```

That pins traffic to the stable variant, avoiding the fallback path. I can open the rollback PR as well.

ashley.k: Sounds good. Devin / Juno — who will own applying the pin and communicating to FinLedger? Maria, we’ll need you to confirm once actioned so we can tell the customer.

devin: I’ll apply the pin and coordinate with CS. Will also post the PR for the fix. ETA: 18 minutes to apply and verify.

maria.cs: I’ll message the customer with the workaround option and say we expect a fix within 2 hours. Please confirm once you apply so I can update them.

juno: Opening PR now for a targeted fix (avoid cache invalidation on variant swap). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/8423 — pinging reviewers @devin @tamir.infra for quick review.

tamir.infra: Reviewing the PR now. If we need a short-term pool restart, I can coordinate a safe window, but let’s try pinning first.

devin: Applied the pin at 09:26 PST and routed FinLedger to redwood-2.1-stable/v1.

juno: I’m running smoke checks against their traffic pattern. Observability shows reduced KV churn so far.

maria.cs: Customer reports fewer errors after the pin. They see latency back to normal baseline. :relieved:

ashley.k: Great. Two immediate commitments: 1) Devin/Juno to push the fix (PR #8423) and merge within 2 hours with a canary rollout to validate; 2) Tamir to prepare rollback playbook + one-call restart procedure if we see recurrence. Maria to keep FinLedger updated.

juno: Agreed. I’ll add test cases for variant swap and KV retention. Targeting merge by EOD, canary rollout 30m after merge.

devin: I’ll pick up final review and help with canary metrics dashboard.

tamir.infra: Playbook draft ready, will attach runbook to INC-4521. If we need to do restart, command is:

```
redwood infra pool restart finledger-dedicated-1 --grace 60 --drain
```

Use only if pinned variant doesn't hold.

ashley.k: Thanks all. Maria once customer confirms full recovery please close/reclass the incident and we’ll schedule a short postmortem. Owner for postmortem: Juno.

maria.cs: Customer confirmed recovery at 09:38 PST. Closing moving to incident review.

juno: I’ll own the postmortem and ship a short summary w/ root cause, why fallback loop triggered, and mitigations (pin, fix PR, tests). ETA for postmortem: 1 business day.

ashley.k: Perfect. Closing the loop here — next actions tracked in INC-4521 and PR #8423. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
